title: Staand Verder Leven: Na De Moord Op Peter R. de Vries
original_title: Staand Verder Leven: Na De Moord Op Peter R. de Vries
overview: Ewout Genemans looks back on the shocking murder of their father together with Peter R. de Vries's children, Royce and Kelly, but he also looks to the future with them. On July 6, 2021, an attack was carried out on the crime reporter following the broadcast of RTL Boulevard. Nine days later, he died of his injuries in the hospital in the presence of his family. What impact has this had?
